questions.question: When the fifth angel sounded his trumpet, what was the star that had fallen from heaven to earth given?

answers.text: The key to the pit of the Abyss
A golden censer full of incense
A sharp sickle for the harvest

questions.question: In a vision of locusts coming out of the Abyss, who were the locusts allowed to harm?

answers.text: Only those without God's seal on their foreheads
Only the kings and the mighty of the earth
Only the people who live along the sea

questions.question: When the sixth angel sounded his trumpet, what were the four angels bound at the Euphrates released to do?

answers.text: Gather the harvest of the earth

questions.question: The people who survived the plagues of the sixth trumpet turned away from their murder, sorcery, sexual immorality and theft. True or false?
